findings.problem: The new married (table 270) and HoH (table 271) bands are labelled only 'married' and 'HoH'. The Method B pseudo-code calls brackets(status) without saying which DE 4 status uses which table. In DE 44 (2026), Table 5 is titled 'Single Persons, Dual Income Married or Married with Multiple Employers' and Table 6 'Married Persons'. The DE 4 statuses are 'Single or Married (with two or more incomes)', 'Married (one income)' and 'Head of household'. An engine that maps every married employee to table 270 under-withholds for dual-income couples.

Record it as a fact (e.g. ca.wh.status_table_map) on US-CAS5-001, and apply the same mapping to the standard-deduction and low-income-exemption tables.
